fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2025-12-21, the complainant left a white scooter bearing registration number TN-28-XX-1063 near Vetri Layout Industrial Area and could not find it later. The time of the incident was given as 04:45 on 2025-12-21. The complaint was lodged by Babu Murugan (9000000226). Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Madhan Murugan, using the number 9000000216. The complaint refers to another person whose identity could not be established. Rajesh Krishnan was mentioned as a person who was present nearby, but no contact number was available. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle allegedly taken after the handle lock was forced.
fields.Keywords: scooter theft, vehicle, scooter, suspect, CCTV, industrial area, mobile number, witness
